lead: A case that completes a TLS handshake builds the process's one outbound client, and every other module's `https` case then panics `AlreadyExists`.
body: `nvs_host::tls::configure` settles one client per process and refuses a call made after any session has run, so a `cache` case dialling `rediss://` ahead of `http::transport`'s `trusted()` decided nine of its cases' outcomes from another module. Call `crate::tests::outbound_client()` before opening a session — it is the one place the client is built, and the `OnceLock` is what makes test order stop mattering.
